info.title: Rebound.ai API
info.description: Generated from packages/contracts/src/schemas/**. Do not hand-edit — run `pnpm --filter @rebound/contracts generate` after changing a schema.

get.summary: Liveness check — no auth required
Get a single exercise-library entry by id
Get the current user's profile + billing status

delete.summary: Permanently delete the current user's account and app data

post.summary: Record a cancellation reason (beta preview — no real subscription exists yet)

get.summary: Get the current user's wake / evening session times

patch.summary: Update the current user's wake / evening session times

post.summary: Submit onboarding answers — screens for crisis/red-flag/cooldown, else kicks off async regime generation

200.description: Always 200 — all four outcomes (crisis_detected/red_flagged/cooldown_active/job_created) are successful screening results, not errors.

get.summary: Poll a regime-generation job's status
Get a regime by id, with its exercise list and (if present) source preset

post.summary: Activate a DRAFT regime — optionally with edited exercises, runs structural + clinical validation first

400.description: Not a DRAFT, or failed structural/clinical validation

post.summary: End the current user's active regime (self-service 'start over')

get.summary: List the current user's session logs, most recent first

post.summary: Log today's pain/exertion check-in — runs the real-time escalation monitor inline

404.description: No active regime to log against

get.summary: Everything the Today screen needs: active regime, today's sessions, today's log, current streak

404.description: No workout session with this id

get.summary: Pain trend, adherence %, weeks active, current streak
Last 60 days, each flagged whether >=1 session was completed
Derived achievement list — nothing persisted
The current user's adjustment events, most recent first
Users with an escalation rollback, a 'made it worse' flag, or a failed regime-generation job

patch.summary: Toggle manual hold for a user — both the escalation monitor and Flow B skip a held user

400.description: A reason is required to enable manual hold

get.summary: Activation funnel, adverse events, flow failure counts, reversal rate
Models available for a dry run
List saved test fixtures

post.summary: Save a new test fixture — payload validated against the real onboarding/adjustment schema

400.description: Payload doesn't match the declared type's shape

delete.summary: Delete a test fixture (blocked if any test run references it)

post.summary: Dry-run Flow A or Flow B against a fixture with a chosen model

get.summary: List the last 50 test runs
Get a test run's full detail, including its LLM call trace

404.description: No test run with this id

get.summary: List logged LLM calls (production and admin-test), most recent first

post.summary: Start a scenario — cycle 0 is a real Flow A dry run against an ONBOARDING fixture

400.description: Unknown model, or fixture isn't ONBOARDING type

get.summary: List scenarios with aggregated cost and latest cycle status

post.summary: Run one more synthetic Flow B cycle against a scenario's most recent valid cycle

400.description: Unknown model, no prior cycle, or the previous cycle isn't VALID

get.summary: Get a scenario's full cycle chain, diffs, and flattened pain timeline

delete.summary: Delete a scenario and every cycle/LLM-call trace under it (cascades)
